description: EtherStore is a classic reentrancy vulnerability example. The contract allows users to deposit and withdraw Ether, but it fails to update the user's balance before making an external call to transfer Ether. An attacker deploys a malicious contract whose fallback function recursively calls withdraw() before the victim's state is updated, draining the entire contract balance. This is the root cause of the 2016 DAO hack. The fix is to follow the Checks-Effects-Interactions pattern: update balances before transferring funds.
